entries.title: Shared/Core update: compaction-policy
entries.summary: New files: `packages/agent-runtime/src/compaction-prompt.ts`, `packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts`.

ai.title: Model-based context compaction replaces mechanical history pruning
ai.summary: The agent runtime now compacts history by prompting the model to write a handoff summary through the new `complete_compaction` tool, replacing the prior mechanical `maybeCompactHistory` pass that rewrote history without an inference request. Compaction runs when the live context approaches the budget returned by `modelCompactionThreshold` (80% of the model window), after an idle gap past the policy's `cacheExpiryMs`, and on a manual `/compact` request, using the run's normal billing and provider via a constrained `compactionTools` tool set. The `ContextCompactionData` callback now carries the saved `summary`, `preTokens`, `postTokens`, and `durationMs` so hosts can log and display the handoff, and `FREEBUFF_CUSTOM_TOOL_NAMES` registers `complete_compaction` so foreign-client detection no longer flags genuine compaction requests.
ai.evidence: New file `packages/agent-runtime/src/model-compaction.ts` exports `compactWithModel`, `compactionTools`, `hasCompactableHistory`, `COMPACTION_TAG`, and `SUMMARY_LIMIT`; `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` imports `compactWithModel` and `compactionTools` and calls `compactWithModel` inside `loopAgentSteps` instead of the removed `maybeCompactHistory`; `common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts` adds `modelCompactionThreshold`; `common/src/types/contracts/llm.ts` extends `ContextCompactionData.trigger` with `manual` and adds `summary`/`preTokens`/`postTokens`/`durationMs`; `common/src/constants/foreign-client-signals.ts` adds `complete_compaction` to `FREEBUFF_CUSTOM_TOOL_NAMES`; `common/src/templates/initial-agents-dir/types/agent-definition.ts` rewords the `compactContext` JSDoc to `model-based`; `packages/agent-runtime/src/prompt-agent-stream.ts` adds `toolChoice` and `maxOutputTokens` params; `sdk/src/run.ts` rewords the `onCompaction` comment.
ai.migration: Agents that previously relied on mechanical compaction behavior should review any code that parsed the old `onCompaction` summary source, since compaction now emits a model-written summary under the `conversation_summary` tag rather than the prior inline rewrite.
ai.unknowns: The exact rollout gate for non-base3 root agents and whether `compactWithModel` failures degrade to the legacy pass on production are not shown in this diff.

changes.what: Added model-based compaction via new `model-compaction.ts` and `compaction-prompt.ts`, wired `compactWithModel` into `loopAgentSteps`, and extended `getAgentStreamFromTemplate` with `toolChoice` and `maxOutputTokens`.

ai.title: Agent runtime guards oversized inputs and bounds tool results into context budget
ai.summary: The agent-runtime package now asserts user content size and bounds tool results against the context budget. A new context-size-guard module exposes assertUserContentSize, which throws on oversized user messages, and boundToolResult, which fits tool output into a quarter of the model context budget. These are wired into the step loop (initial and steered user messages) and tool executor (all tool results entering message history), replacing the previous gpt-tokenizer-based counting in context-token-count and token-counter with cheap length estimates anchored to each model response's usage.
